design: Station LOO; held station excluded from current and historical inputs. Calibration coefficients locked before acquiring three evaluation times. Current observations only, no NWP.
limitations: Single late-autumn weather episode; no independent seasonal accuracy guarantee.
All held-out station temperature and wind observations are excluded, including history. Catalogue height substitutes for target DEM.
Calibration reweights frozen baseline contributors; evaluation runs the full application estimator including fallback gates.
One 30-minute history frame simulates a warmed session. A cold session deliberately retains the baseline until enough observations accumulate.
Improvement is about 0.001C, not established practical or statistically significant accuracy improvement.
Among the same baseline-estimated targets, the 95th percentile error increases slightly. Individual frames or locations may worsen.
Night lapse attenuation, night height reweighting and temperature trend reweighting were evaluated but not adopted.
Runtime uses received observations only; no backfill requests. Research assumes one valid 30-minute earlier frame.

adoption.reason: The wind candidate worsens the 95th percentile error among baseline estimates and RMSE at individual evaluation times. User rejected adopting such deterioration. Runtime remains baseline.
adoption.revisedRule: Both all outputs and matched baseline-estimated targets must not worsen MAE, RMSE, 95th percentile or maximum absolute error; per-frame MAE/RMSE must not worsen. Revalidate independently before enabling.
